usage: Nine aircraft-specific exhaust atlases, sixteen generated frames each. Original RGBA outputs are retained without pixel edits.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game VFX spritesheet for VIPER (black_eagle), cyan ion fighter engine exhaust. Transparent RGBA background. ONE square 1024x1024 atlas with exactly 16 UNIQUE sequential animation frames in a precise 4 columns x 4 rows grid of 256x256 cells, row-major. No text, labels, grid lines, border, aircraft, engine hardware or backdrop. Every cell shows ONE slender luminous cyan-blue exhaust jet, white-hot ignition at the TOP center (x=128 y=24 within each cell), directed vertically DOWN toward y=224. Strong narrow nozzle root, elongated tapered plume, crisp luminous shock diamonds and wispy blue feathering. Max plume width 96px centered in cell; at least 24px clear margin. Same root position and scale in every frame, distinct turbulent flame shape in all 16 frames, natural looping propulsion pulse (expand then contract). Rich detailed raster painted space shooter VFX, readable tiny. NOT identical pasted copies. True alpha transparency, no checkerboard drawn. Avoid huge bloom, smoke clouds, sideways flames. Make the luminous root visible and tightly registered at the same x,y.
